development_roadmap.strategy: Foundation then demonstrable vertical slices, with risky integrations proven before release hardening.

phases.name: Execution foundation
phases.goal: Create the selected-stack monorepo, shared contracts, tenant boundary, data schema, queue, and UI foundation.
readiness_criteria: pnpm workspace builds
Prisma test migration succeeds
Clerk organization maps to workspace context
BullMQ job contract is shared
App shell and design tokens render responsively

phases.name: Catalog and provider baseline
phases.goal: Deliver vendor/catalog/manual workflows and provider routing before risky ingestion paths.
readiness_criteria: Manual item path works with zero AI providers
Catalog search/filter is tenant scoped
Provider credentials remain server side
Provider health and routing states are visible

phases.name: Import-to-discovery vertical slices
phases.goal: Deliver website and PDF imports through observable jobs into the review-first Discovery Session.
readiness_criteria: Website and PDF inputs create idempotent jobs
Partial failures and retries are visible
Candidates never bypass deterministic validation
Bulk outcomes are per-record and recoverable

phases.name: Release hardening
phases.goal: Close security, accessibility, integration, observability, and rollout gates.
readiness_criteria: Launch-critical E2E workflows pass
Tenant isolation and credential checks pass
Responsive and keyboard evidence is registered
Rollback and operational checks are rehearsed

phases.name: Supported scraper repair
phases.goal: Replace single-page fetch behavior with an operational, platform-aware, browser-capable, resumable, secure, and measurable website ingestion workflow.
readiness_criteria: Worker claim and restart recovery are automatic
Shopify and generic JavaScript fixture matrices pass at 100 percent
Blank Knights passes three consecutive controlled live canaries
Category selection, job status, retry, and evidence are browser verified
Security and crawl-compliance gates pass
The 100 percent claim is limited to the declared supported matrix

milestones.name: Foundation contracts frozen
exit_criteria: pnpm workspace builds
Prisma test migration succeeds
Clerk organization maps to workspace context
BullMQ job contract is shared
App shell and design tokens render responsively

milestones.name: Manual catalog and provider baseline demonstrable
exit_criteria: Manual item path works with zero AI providers
Catalog search/filter is tenant scoped
Provider credentials remain server side
Provider health and routing states are visible

milestones.name: Import-to-catalog workflows demonstrable
exit_criteria: Website and PDF inputs create idempotent jobs
Partial failures and retries are visible
Candidates never bypass deterministic validation
Bulk outcomes are per-record and recoverable

milestones.name: Private alpha release candidate
exit_criteria: Launch-critical E2E workflows pass
Tenant isolation and credential checks pass
Responsive and keyboard evidence is registered
Rollback and operational checks are rehearsed

milestones.name: Supported scraper release candidate
exit_criteria: All repair tickets TICKET-029 through TICKET-039 pass in dependency order
Supported golden fixtures have 100 percent expected-field and URL coverage with zero duplicates
Blank Knights passes three consecutive controlled live canaries
Restart, partial failure, unsupported-site, security denial, and manual-review outcomes are verified
Browser click-through and responsive screenshot evidence are registered
